what: White plates and photo fragments inside the plate each follow the scroll stickily (scrub 2) from their own scattered positions (px for a 1424px screen, and a 376px basis for phone — proportional to screen width) and gather into place. It starts when the plate’s top edge is 250px past the top of the screen and gathers with power1.out over 1050px of scroll, once everything has gathered, is-fx-gathered is added to the plate so the title and text can be shown. If scrolled past, it is pinned to the end state, if scrolled back up, to the scattered state · With steps, each fragment starts 70px later, so they arc and jerk cell by cell and gather twisted ±15° per cell (the scene where Brand’s pebble logo laid in a line on the floor stacks up into a face)

options.start: Start — when the panel’s top edge has passed this many px (at base width) from the top of the screen, default 250 (if negative, that much earlier)
options.length: Scroll length (px, base width) for gathering, default 1050
options.base-sp: Base width at 767px and below, default 376
options.ease: Curve, default power1.out (original ease:"ease" is a name GSAP doesn’t have, so it runs on defaults)
options.data-key: Per piece "x y" Scattered position (px, at reference width) — if the phone value differs "x y | phone x phone y"
options.steps: At 0 it stays as above (all at once, straight). At 2 or more each piece moves separately — drawing an arc and stepping in that many steps (steps(n)), with shake and tilt mixed per step. Brand uses 21
options.each: (when steps) Distance each piece starts late per turn (px, reference width), default 70
options.arc: (for steps) size range the arc swells over "Small to large"(px, reference width), default "50 150" — Each piece picks from within this
options.jitter: (for steps) per-cell jitter mixed in (px, base width), default 4
options.spin: (When steps) Tilt range mixed in per cell (± degrees), default 15
options.lean: (when steps) share multiplied into the horizontal arc · jitter, default .5
options.scrub (when steps): "Small to large" If given, each piece picks a lag within that range in .2 steps, so each follows with a different delay, default "0.1 1"
